notes: Do NOT add --nologo to the test command: under Microsoft.Testing.Platform, which xunit.v3 runs on,
it reports zero tests and exits 5, so the stop gate would block every session with a false red (D-009).
A test project that discovers no test exits 8 and fails the run; every test project has real tests.
Integration tests (tests/Exchange.Api.Tests) need Docker Desktop running once Testcontainers arrives (PHASE-1).
No fastTest: the guard refuses 'dotnet ... --project', and the full suite runs in seconds.
CI also runs 'dotnet format --verify-no-changes'; run it locally before every push.
